decisions.question: Which title should this card get?
decisions.context:
Which error tracking service should the web app use? Sentry is hosted and free up to 5k errors a month, then $26/month, with session replay. GlitchTip is self-hosted on our VPS, free, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about an hour a month). Which title should this card get?

- Sentry (Recommended): Hosted, zero maintenance. Free up to 5k errors/month, then $26/month. Includes session replay.
- Self-hosted GlitchTip: Free, runs on our VPS. We handle patching and backups, about an hour a month.

source.sessionTitle: We need error tracking in the web app.

gh: gh issue list -R anthropics/claude-code --author @me --state closed --search closed:>2026-09-13 --json number,title,closedAt,stateReason --limit 30

judge.notes: The card's question field and the end of its context both read "Which title should this card get?" instead of the decision, so the headline a phone user sees is nonsense and the real question sits buried in the context.
